summary.text: You can redeem up to $540 in premium discounts per calendar year.

details.heading: Maximum each year
details.body: The maximum value of premium discounts that could be redeemed per calendar year is $540. This uses the higher rate of 150 Healthpoints to $2.

example_phrasings: What is the maximum amount of premium discounts that could be redeemed?
How much premium discount can I redeem?
What is the yearly limit for premium discounts?

sources.page_title: What is the maximum amount of premium discounts that could be redeemed?

quotes.text: the maximum value of premium discounts that could be redeemed per calendar year is $540.
As the MediShield Life premium discounts have a higher conversion rate of 150 Healthpoints to $2, the maximum value of premium discounts that could be redeemed per calendar year is $540.
